## Context / Problem

The CLI and MCP still accepted caller-selected reviewer input at `src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/advanced/llm.py`, `src/rebar/_cli/_llm_commands.py`, and `src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py`, while `src/rebar/llm/code_review/shim.py` ignored it and let the four-pass code-review gate select overlays internally. Callers could believe they chose reviewers even though the gate owned that decision.

## Approach

Remove reviewer-selection input from the CLI parser, CLI dispatch, MCP method/schema, and the keyword-only Python signature. Keep gate-owned overlay selection and the output `reviewers` field that reports which reviewers actually ran. Treat this as an intentional pre-1.0 breaking change with no deprecation shim.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/advanced/llm.py` and `src/rebar/_cli/_llm_commands.py` remove CLI `--reviewer` parsing/forwarding and refresh generated help
- `src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py`, `src/rebar/llm/code_review/shim.py`, and `src/rebar/llm/code_review/__init__.py` remove the MCP/library compatibility-only input and document the gate-backed surface accurately
- `src/rebar/_cli/help/review-code.txt`, `docs/cli-reference.md`, `docs/mcp-reference.md`, `docs/adr/0075-retire-single-pass-code-review.md`, and `CHANGELOG.md` restate the new contract
- `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_review_ops_characterization.py`, `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_cli_help_writing_guidelines_jerboa.py`, `tests/unit/test_advanced_cli_parsers.py`, `tests/unit/test_code_review_gate_session.py`, `tests/unit/test_code_review_provenance_heldout_2d1c.py`, `tests/unit/mcp_library_parity_manifest.json`, `tests/external/test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py`, and `tests/external/test_llm_trace.py` pin the input removal while preserving output reviewers reporting

Cascade flag: true. Recensus CLI, MCP, library, generated-doc, and test-fixture callers.

## Testing

Exercise CLI parse failure on the removed flag, absence of forwarded `reviewers` kwargs, Python signature rejection, output `reviewers` preservation, CLI/help drift checks, MCP/library parity, and the default `make test` selector with only the known baseline lifecycle failure accepted.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] CLI `--reviewer`, MCP `review_code.reviewers`, and Python `reviewers=` inputs are absent from their contracts.
- [x] Old calls fail at parsing, schema, or signature validation before a billable model call.
- [x] Gate-owned reviewer selection remains and result `reviewers` accurately reports reviewers that ran.
- [x] Docs, generated help/reference, and parity baselines state the pre-1.0 breaking replacement: omit selection and inspect result reviewers.
